faq.a: Yes. We inspect the roof and give you a written quote, with no obligation.

faq.q: What do you do after a storm?
faq.a: We inspect the roof, photograph the damage and give you a written estimate for the repair. If water is getting in, we tarp the roof first.

faq.q: How long does a new roof take?
faq.a: It depends on the size of the roof and the weather. We give you a schedule before we start.

faq.q: Are you licensed, and what coverage do you carry?
faq.a: We are licensed in North Carolina and carry general liability insurance.

home.cta_text: Call now, or ask for a free inspection and we will call you back.

services.headline: Roofing services in Charlotte
services.lead: Replacements, repairs, storm work and care for the roof you already have.
services.intro: Whatever the roof needs, the answer starts with an honest look at it. Pick a service to see what we do and when it makes sense.

contact.headline: Talk to Oakline Roofing
contact.lead: Tell us a little about your roof and we will call you back.
contact.response_line: We only use your number to call you about your roof.

service_pages.lead: A new roof, planned around your home and your budget.
service_pages.what: We remove the old roof down to the deck, repair what is damaged, and install new underlayment, flashing and shingles. We explain the plan before we start.
signs: Shingles that curl, crack or fall off

faq.q: How do I know it is time to replace?
faq.a: When repairs keep coming back or the damage covers much of the roof, a new roof may make more sense than another repair. We inspect first and tell you plainly.

faq.q: Can I stay home during the work?
faq.a: Yes. Ask us what to expect on the day.

faq.q: Do you take care of the permit?
faq.a: Ask us what the job needs and what to expect.

service_pages.lead: Leaks and damage fixed at the source.
service_pages.what: We find where the water gets in, which is often not where the stain shows, and fix that. We tell you if the roof needs more than a repair.
signs: A stain on a ceiling or wall

faq.q: Can you repair just one spot?
faq.a: Often yes. If the rest of the roof is sound, a repair is the sensible choice, and we say so.
Call and we will tell you when we can come.

faq.q: Will the repair match my roof?
faq.a: We match your shingles as closely as the stock allows and tell you if a match will show.

service_pages.lead: We inspect, document and repair storm damage.
service_pages.what: After hail or wind we inspect the roof, photograph the damage and give you a written report and an estimate for the repair. If water is getting in, we tarp the roof first.
signs: Dents on vents, gutters or flashing
Shingles lifted or missing after wind
A branch or debris on the roof
includes: A written estimate for the repair

faq.q: Do I have to use you for the repair?
faq.a: No. You choose your roofer. The report and the estimate are yours to keep.

faq.q: Can you stop a leak right away?
faq.a: Yes. If water is getting in, we tarp the roof first and plan the repair from there.

faq.q: How long after a storm should I call?
faq.a: As soon as it is safe. Water that gets in keeps doing damage, so call sooner rather than later.
